svg.aria-label: Unified memory, in testing: about 30 fps in the open world on first stretches, 35 ms a frame over 100 frames on an RTX 5080; 22 ms of GPU work per open-world frame with the game's data in video memory; 4 times faster than the copy loop; 3,000 times less memory bookkeeping per frame on recorded gameplay; 42 seconds from launch to the open world with loading screens at 30 fps; 121 million descriptor rows checked with zero errors; open-world frame time on the direct path from about 29 seconds to 35 milliseconds.
